very lucky or auspicious (as a day), Kathās.
very noble (as a deed), R.
सु—शुद्ध mfn. perfectly pure or bright, Viṣṇ.; Hcat.
सु—शुक्ल mfn. very white, Mahāvy.
सु—शुक्वन् (RV.) or सु—शुक्वनि (VS.), mfn. shining brightly, brilliant.
सु—श्व mfn. having a happy to-morrow, Pāṇ. v, 4, 120.
